Based on my analysis of the fixture repository (`loc-spread`), the scheduler's draining loop lives in the Vue runtime-core scheduler. The core drain is `flushJobs`, which walks the `queue` array and runs each job in order; the post-flush and pre-flush callback queues are drained by `flushPostFlushCbs` and `flushPreFlushCbs`; `queuePostFlushCb` feeds the post-flush queue; and Suspense's `while (parent)` walk merges buffered effects into unresolved pending ancestors.
